process.title: From Our Farm to Your Container
process.subtitle: Vertical integration means we control quality at every stage

steps.title: Cultivation
steps.description: 3,500 cashew trees across 35 hectares in Odienné. Organic agroforestry. No synthetic chemicals. Farm OS tracks every block.

steps.title: Processing
steps.description: Phase 1 pilot facility (1,000-2,000 MT/year). Chemical-free shelling. Export-grade grading and vacuum packaging.

steps.title: Export
steps.description: FOB Abidjan. Full documentation package: COO, SGS, Phyto, Organic + Halal certs. Direct to EU, Middle East, and North America.

quality.title: Quality Specifications
quality.description: Every shipment meets export-grade standards. Moisture content, defect rates, and aflatoxin levels are measured and documented per batch.
bullets: Grade A cashews with consistent sizing (W320, W240, W180)
Full traceability to specific farm blocks via Farm OS
Laboratory testing for aflatoxins, moisture, and contaminants

certifications.title: Certification Roadmap
certifications.body: Every product we ship is backed by verified traceability. While our certifications are in progress, our farm operates on strict organic principles today, and our future processing facility is designed to exceed international food safety standards. We are building the proof layer that European and North American buyers require.
certifications.cardSubtitle: Each certification unlocks a specific premium market. Timelines reflect current progress and target completion dates.
